title: Ronaldo and Felix Return to Al-Nassr Attack Against Al-Khaleej
seoTitle: Ronaldo and Felix Return to Al-Nassr Attack vs Al-Khaleej
subtitle: The clash highlights the partnership that could decide the title race
excerpt: Al-Nassr will once again feature the Ronaldo-Felix duo on the field against Al-Khaleej in the seventh round of the Saudi Pro League.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Al-Nassr will once again feature the Ronaldo-Felix duo on the field against Al-Khaleej in the seventh round of the Saudi Pro League. The encounter promises to test Riyadh's offensive superiority, while Al-Khaleej looks to break their winless streak.

Al-Nassr Strengthens Attack with Ronaldo and Felix

Al-Nassr has set its lineup for the match against Al-Khaleej. João Felix returns to the squad after missing the 2-1 victory over Abha. He joins the front line alongside Cristiano Ronaldo and Sadio Mane, forming an attacking trio that is highly anticipated by fans.

Al-Khaleej Aims to Break Winless Run

Al-Khaleej sits in 13th place in the table with just four points. The club seeks to end its winless streak, while the head-to-head record favors Al-Nassr, who have won the last five encounters between the teams.

Lineups and Coaches' Preparations

Al-Khaleej coach José Gomes and Al-Nassr manager Ange Postecoglou are already in their dressing rooms, putting the finishing touches before the match. Al-Nassr, with 15 points, remains in second place, while Al-Khaleej attempts to change the narrative at home.

Stadium and Match Atmosphere

The match will be played at the Al-Khaleej Club Stadium in Saihat. The stadium, inaugurated in 1996, accommodates 10,150 spectators and offers a close-to-the-field environment, which typically increases the intensity of games in the eastern region.

Performance Expectation and Table Impact

Securing the three points would maintain pressure at the top of the table and extend Al-Nassr's positive run. The clash offers a fresh test of the team's ability to convert offensive superiority into goals.
